decisive_spans.text: Trans-thoracic echocardiography (TTE) showed a large left ventricular (LV) mass
Trans-esophageal echocardiography (TEE) noted a pedunculated LV mass emanating from the basal septum protruding into the LV cavity
Endomyocardial biopsies revealed a malignant spindle cell tumor, histology consistent with the monophasic variant

response.rationale: The vignette describes a malignant spindle cell tumor found in the left ventricle, which is consistent with cardiac sarcoma. The other options are either too general (Leiomyosarcoma) or contradicted by the biopsy results (Intracardiac Metastasis). Renal infarction is a finding, not the primary diagnosis.
